run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy with an ASE calculator
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute hybrid adsorption energy using ML-relaxed adslab energies and DFT slab reference energies
relax_adslab_with_surface: relax an adslab system with surface relaxation enabled to compute full ML adsorption energy
save_relaxed_adslab_atoms: run adsorb_atoms with save_relaxed_atoms enabled to encode and return relaxed atom configurations as JSON
review_adsorb_atoms: review the adsorb_atoms function that computes direct, hybrid, and full adsorption energy metrics
